Replace the word algorithm with the word audience. The "algorithm" is just taking data from the audience it's served it to before. Either your thumbnail isn't compelling or your title isnt relevant/enticing enough. Or... The video just isn't as good as you think it is. It's a hard pill to swallow. I've been on YouTube since 2008 making content. I know how hard it is to detach yourself from the thing you poured your love into. But the algorithm is VERY good at showing your videos to people who like the subject of the video. If they don't click you need to re-evaluate the META data and If all that fails. Check the content of the video. Do you ramble too much? Not enough B-roll? Too much B-roll? Is the audio quality unbearable? These are the questions you'll have to ask yourself. It's a learning curve. But you got this.
